answer: The trend in the average number of AI-related sentences per 10-K filing from 2020 to 2024 shows a steady increase each year. Specifically, the average number of unique AI-related sentences per filing among those that include at least one AI mention has risen from 4.96 in 2020 to 9.27 in 2024. This indicates not only a rise in the number of companies discussing AI but also a growing prominence of the topic in their disclosures.
